goal: Implement the approved Supernote Cloud change ledger and agent read/write contracts: use an allowlist of Cloud notebooks, snapshot stable page IDs and content hashes, record added/updated/removed/reordered pages, OCR only new or changed pages, support explicit and per-agent cursors, make cached reads available, harden the existing write route with base-revision concurrency checks, and return Pydantic/Instructor-style structured error guidance across CLI/API/event surfaces. Preserve existing safe upload behavior and verify with focused unit/integration tests.

end_state.contract: The paia-supernote service has a durable SQLite-backed Cloud change ledger for allowlisted notebooks, exposes safe cached agent read/write contracts with cursor-based reads and base-revision guarded writes, and returns structured recoverable error guidance across existing CLI/event/API-like surfaces without weakening dry-run or upload safety.
acceptance_criteria: Configuration supports an explicit allowlist of Cloud notebooks for ledger-backed ingest; non-allowlisted notebooks are ignored before download/OCR/mutation where existing Cloud metadata allows.
Ledger snapshots store notebook revision identity, stable page IDs, ordered page lists, page content hashes, and notebook content hashes in SQLite or the existing configured state store.
Diffing records added, updated, removed, and reordered pages with enough metadata for explicit-cursor and per-agent-cursor reads.
OCR is invoked only for pages whose stable ID is new or whose content hash changed; reorder-only diffs do not trigger OCR.
Cached reads return latest allowlisted notebook/page state and change batches without contacting Supernote Cloud.
Write routes require caller-supplied base revision or ledger revision and fail closed on stale, missing, or mismatched revisions before upload/apply/S3 calls.
CLI, event, and any in-repo API-like surfaces use Pydantic models with machine-readable code, message, retryability, next actions, and conflict details where applicable.
Existing safe upload behavior remains intact: dry-run paths do not mutate Cloud data, real notebook writes remain explicitly guarded, and tests do not touch production Supernote notebooks.
Focused unit tests, offline integration tests, ruff, git diff checks, roborev, and final pytest gates pass.
out_of_scope: Real Supernote Cloud notebook mutations during test execution.
New browser organizer UI features or UI redesign.
Native Supernote cross-notebook links or generated index pages.
Dependency upgrades or uv.lock churn unless strictly required and explicitly reviewed.
Broad refactors unrelated to ledger, cached reads, write concurrency, and structured error propagation.
Automatic Quick.note triage or page moving.

Review duplicates an already-tested scenario without new evidence.
nodes.rollback_notes: Review artifacts can be superseded by a new round; do not modify code directly in this node.
escalation_conditions: A blocking safety finding cannot be reproduced with fixtures.
Review identifies architectural contradiction with the approved design.

routing.selection_reason: Critical cross-system adversarial safety review requires premium reasoning.
escalation_conditions: Review cannot determine if a Cloud mutation path is safe.
Two review rounds fail to converge.

nodes.title: Repair blocking test, drift, or review findings
nodes.description: Address blocking findings from tests, drift gates, or adversarial review with bounded repairs, then rerun exact failing commands.
verify: uv run ruff check src/ tests/
acceptance: All blocking findings are fixed or escalated with evidence.
Exact failing commands from the gate or review pass after repair.
No repair expands scope beyond named contract modules, tests, docs, or artifacts.
Any touch outside the named touch set requires explicit authorization recorded in fix-loop.md.
read_first: git diff --stat output captured by prior nodes
implementation_steps: Classify findings as blocking, advisory, duplicate, or out of scope.
Patch only the smallest named source/test/doc set needed for blocking findings.
For write-safety or secdrift findings, escalate to premium after one failed repair attempt.
Rerun the exact command that failed before running broad gates.
Record repair attempts and remaining risks.
edge_cases: Finding requires live Cloud validation.
Fix conflicts with approved design.
Same failure recurs after two attempts.
A needed file is outside the bounded touch set.
nodes.rollback_notes: Use git diff to revert unsuccessful repair patches; do not revert unrelated successful contract implementation.
escalation_conditions: One repair attempt fails for a write-safety/security finding.
Two repair attempts fail for any non-security issue class.
Repair requires new dependency, migration, or live Cloud access.
Fix would weaken write-route safety or allowlist enforcement.

routing.selection_reason: Repairs are merge-sensitive shared-contract work; standard is sufficient unless write-safety/security escalation triggers premium.
escalation_conditions: The same non-security failure repeats after two repair attempts.
A write-safety or security finding fails after one repair attempt.
The repair touches write-safety architecture.

nodes.title: Final status, commit, push, and handoff
nodes.description: Verify final state, isolate unrelated dirty files, commit scoped changes, pull --rebase, push, update Workgraph status when dispatch was confirmed, and hand off residual risks.
verify: uv run ruff check src/ tests/
acceptance: Only scoped implementation, tests, docs, and plan artifacts are committed.
Pre-existing unrelated dirty files are preserved or explicitly excluded from the commit.
Quality gates pass immediately before commit.
git push succeeds and final status reports branch up to date with origin or records any remote policy blocker.
Handoff artifact lists commands run, changed files, follow-up issues, residual risks, and the cached-ledger TOCTOU note.
Workgraph status is updated only if dispatch was confirmed; otherwise manual-runtime fallback is recorded.
implementation_steps: Run final verification commands.
Review git diff and stage only scoped files.
Create follow-up Workgraph tasks or issues for accepted residual work.
Commit with a concise supernote-scoped message.
Run git pull --rebase, resolve conflicts without touching unrelated files, then git push.
Record final status, Workgraph update status, and handoff notes.
edge_cases: Repository is already ahead of origin before this plan.
Unrelated dirty files remain in worktree.
Remote rebase conflicts with concurrent changes.
Push is rejected by remote policy.
Workgraph was executed manually because speedriftd remained stalled.
nodes.rollback_notes: Before commit, unstage with git restore --staged; after a failed rebase, use git rebase --abort and replan if conflicts affect unrelated dirty files.
escalation_conditions: Final tests fail after a passing fix loop.
git pull --rebase conflicts with unrelated dirty files.
Push fails for credentials or remote policy.

routing.selection_reason: Final handoff is merge-sensitive and includes commit/push decisions, so standard routing is required rather than cheap.
escalation_conditions: Rebase conflict touches write-safety or ledger contracts.
Remote state suggests another agent changed the same contract files.

constraints: Pi remains the Workgraph runtime for every node.
Agency profiles are preferred for review support when available but must not dispatch broad autonomous backlog work.
If Agency is unavailable, continue with Pi-selected models or manual Pi execution and record the fallback in the node output.
Agency review must respect the approved scope and must not request live Supernote Cloud mutations.
Agency fallback discipline is checked post-task via agencydrift and cannot silently switch to Codex or Claude defaults.
Available execution models for this run are limited to openai-codex/gpt-5.5 and zai/glm-5.2.

adversarial_review.boundary: Review only the approved Cloud change ledger, cached read/cursor contract, base-revision write safety including documented poll-interval TOCTOU risk, structured errors, existing CLI/event/API-like surfaces found in repo, tests, docs, dependency drift, Workgraph readiness, and preservation of existing safe upload behavior.
stop_conditions: All blocking stale-write, allowlist, cursor, OCR-skip, structured-error, dependency-drift, and Workgraph-readiness findings are fixed.
Remaining findings are advisory and have documented follow-up tasks or residual-risk acceptance.
Two rounds complete without new blocking evidence.
must_not: Do not request real Supernote Cloud writes or production notebook mutations.
Do not broaden scope into organizer UI redesign, native links, or automatic Quick.note triage.
Do not introduce new dependencies or lockfile changes unless a blocking implementation need is proven.
Do not weaken dry-run behavior, upload sequencing, or base-revision checks to satisfy tests.
Do not require live Cloud validation to close an offline fixture-backed safety review without explicit human approval.

fix_loops.trigger: Focused unit or integration test failure
fix_loops.action: Create or use the fix-loop node, patch the smallest failing contract area, and rerun the exact failing command before broad gates.
fix_loops.escalation: If the same non-security failure class recurs twice, stop and replan with premium routing.

fix_loops.action: Block handoff, repair the finding, add regression coverage, and rerun the exact write-safety command before broader gates.
fix_loops.escalation: Escalate to premium review and ask the human if repair requires live Cloud validation or broader architecture change.

fix_loops.trigger: Unrelated dirty files, lockfile drift, or merge conflict threatens scoped commit
fix_loops.action: Do not stage unrelated files; isolate the intended diff, document unresolved dirty state, and re-run git status.
fix_loops.escalation: Ask the human before touching unrelated uv.lock, _pull_ooda.py, or _pull_p29.py changes.

fix_loops.trigger: Any path would require real Supernote Cloud mutation during verification
fix_loops.action: Stop that path, replace with fixture-backed validation, and record the live-validation gap as a residual risk or follow-up.
fix_loops.escalation: Ask the human for explicit approval before any production-like Cloud operation.

drift_gates.name: post-task data, UX, and Agency fallback drift

handoff.completion_policy: Complete only after scoped changes are verified, reviewed, committed, pushed, Workgraph status is updated when dispatch was confirmed, manual fallback is documented when used, and residual risks/follow-ups are recorded.

risks.risk: Stable page IDs may not exist in all parsed .note fixtures or older notebook formats.
risks.mitigation: Implement and document a deterministic fallback hash strategy only after tests prove reorder stability; escalate if impossible.

risks.risk: Base-revision validation against cached ledger state leaves a TOCTOU window if Cloud changes after the last poll and before write.
risks.mitigation: Document the poll_interval-bounded freshness window in write-safety output and handoff; do not claim live Cloud conflict prevention unless approved design adds a live pre-write fetch.

risks.risk: Base-revision checks might be bypassed by an older direct uploader call path.
risks.mitigation: Use uploader spies and integration tests to prove conflict checks happen before upload and review direct upload APIs in roborev.

risks.risk: Structured error envelopes may diverge across CLI, event, and API-like surfaces.
risks.mitigation: Centralize Pydantic models and test every reachable surface against the same serialized fields.

risks.risk: Pre-existing dirty files or ahead-of-origin state may complicate final commit/push.
risks.mitigation: Inspect git status before edits, stage only scoped paths, and escalate before touching unrelated uv.lock or pull helper scripts.

risks.risk: Workgraph and speedriftd evidence conflict, with service running but speedriftd stalled under a stale April lease.
risks.mitigation: Root task must refresh/release the stale lease or explicitly record manual Pi execution before materializing nodes; handoff Workgraph update is conditional on confirmed dispatch.
